blurb: A museum under a vast lace dome, telling the history of art as one story of all humanity.

facts.t: Jean Nouvel's dome, 180 metres wide, is made of almost 8,000 metal stars in layers, so sunlight falls through in moving spots. The museum opened in 2017 under a 30-year agreement with France.

The Salvator Mundi, attributed to Leonardo, sold in 2017 for $450 million, the highest price ever paid for a painting. It was announced for this museum, but it has not been shown in public since. Experts still argue whether Leonardo painted it.
